long_biography.plain_text:
Business executive David Sokol grew up reading newspaper stories aloud at Sunday dinners. His father selected accounts of local entrepreneurs and donors, encouraging the children to see such achievements as attainable. Sokol later worked nights managing a grocery store while attending university during the day.

At NetJets, he involved employees across the business in reducing costs while protecting safety and the service customers had purchased. He also advocated integrating Marquis Jet more closely into sales planning, so aircraft capacity and demand could be managed together. Rather than pursue expansion at any pace, he favoured slower growth when necessary to maintain service quality.

Business executive David Sokol grew up reading newspaper stories aloud at Sunday dinners. His father selected accounts of local entrepreneurs and donors, encouraging the children to see such achievements as attainable. Sokol later worked nights managing a grocery store while attending university during the day.

At NetJets, he involved employees across the business in reducing costs while protecting safety and the service customers had purchased. He also advocated integrating Marquis Jet more closely into sales planning, so aircraft capacity and demand could be managed together. Rather than pursue expansion at any pace, he favoured slower growth when necessary to maintain service quality.
